errors.evidence: The labeled y-axis ticks go from 0 to 3000. Stating that the range is from 0 to over 3500 is an inaccurate description of the visible axis scale, even though the highest data point is 3516.
The phrase '远高于' (far higher than) is a subjective interpretation of the difference between the values. A neutral description should simply state the values for comparison.

The phrase '显著快于' (significantly faster than) is an evaluative and interpretive statement. In a scientific context, 'significant' implies a statistical test which is not presented. A neutral description should avoid such subjective qualifiers.
